message.content: According to the conversation between LiHua and Emily Burnett, Emily appreciates the stunning visual aspects of "The Rings of Power." Specifically, LiHua mentions that the series has "stunning visuals," which Emily agrees with and finds particularly helpful in understanding the rich lore of Middle-earth that ties into the series. This indicates that the visual quality of the show plays a significant role in Emily's enjoyment and appreciation of "The Rings of Power."
